system.description:
You can deliver nasty attacks that leave your opponents gasping.

Prerequisite: Sneak Attack or Rapid Shot or Rapid Strike

Effect: Any time you would deal additional damage from a Feat or Talent that grants one or more extra dice of damage, you can forgo the extra damage to move the target 2 squares per extra die sacrificed. This movement does not provoke Attacks of Opportunity.

prerequisite.text: Sneak Attack or Rapid Shot or Rapid Strike
